name: file-capability
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: plants a copy of an interpreter (python3 by default) with a dangerous file capability (cap_setuid+ep by default) -- a quieter privilege escalation than setuid. Needs setcap (libcap2-bin). Vars: DEST (required); SRC (optional, default python3); CAP (optional, default cap_setuid+ep).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${DEST:?DEST is required}"
src="${SRC:-$(command -v python3 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/python3)}"
cap="${CAP:-cap_setuid+ep}"
command -v setcap >/dev/null 2>&1 || { export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get install -y libcap2-bin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$DEST")"
cp -f "$src" "$DEST"
setcap "$cap" "$DEST"
